# EIDLIP

> EIDLIP is a Bangladeshi unisex clothing brand offering premium shirts, t-shirts, pants and everyday wear with cash on delivery across Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Shop premium unisex clothing — shirts, t-shirts, pants and everyday wear.
- [About](/about): The EIDLIP story, brand values and craftsmanship.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the EIDLIP team.
- [Blog](/blog): Style guides, fashion tips and brand updates.

## Optional

- [Shipping Policy](/shipping-policy): Delivery timeframes and charges across Bangladesh.
- [Refund & Return Policy](/refund-policy): Return eligibility, exchange and refund process.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms): Orders, payments and usage terms.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How we collect and protect your data.
